# opnsense_nginx_proxy_cache_valid (Resource)

nginx cache validity rules (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Cache Validity**, plugin `os-nginx`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_proxy_cache_valid" "ok_responses" {
  description = "cache-ok"
  code        = ["200", "301"]
  valid       = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Brief description for reference. No spaces, tabs or double quotes.
- `valid` (Number) Specify caching time in minutes.

### Optional

- `code` (Set of String) Enter a Respone codes or use "any" to cache any responses. Defaults to `["any"]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx cache validity rule.
